maintenance_protocol: Serialize installers/uninstallers by stable management reservation; persist MAINTENANCE_REQUESTED. Consumer acquires use lease then reads gate/journal before marker/config/profile access; if intent is pending it releases and refuses. Existing counted users may perform controlled safe exit.

Capture owned Electron/Core identities before Safe Exit because normal exit removes witness. Drain/settle/checkpoint, then verify those exact identities exited; no blind kill or missing-witness inference.

After use leases drain, acquire exclusive maintenance lease. Then acquire data coordinator lease for consistent snapshot; retain stable gate while releasing/swapping/reacquiring in validated order. Holding data/coordinator.lock alone does not cover directory swaps.

Journal PREPARED → OLD_PROGRAM_SAVED → NEW_PROGRAM_PLACED → DATA_PLACED → INTEGRATION_APPLIED → VERIFYING → COMMITTED, with profile/config substeps and ROLLING_BACK/ROLLED_BACK/NEEDS_RECOVERY. Verify filesystem/hash facts during recovery.

Only a transaction-bound one-use validation admission may launch candidate while maintenance blocks ordinary clients. On failure stop verified owned candidate before rollback; if stop cannot be proved preserve both sides and require recovery.
